done_when: With unread `T-9` messages for lineages A and B, `desk(lineage=A)` returns A only; repeated continuation-page queries still exclude B.
impact: When separate projects reuse `T-9`, the T-9 receiver's desk can return unread metadata from another lineage, contaminating its project-local work.
observation: `desk` filters cases by `lineage`, but `ws.query_inbox(... topic=work ...)` receives no lineage; `notify` stores shared-mailbox messages under topic `work` while lineage appears only in `notify_key`.
request: Add a lineage parameter to the inbox query contract; pass the checked lineage from `desk`. Add a shared-mailbox regression fixture with identical Work IDs across two lineages.
uncertainty: `query_inbox` internals are omitted; it may already partition by lineage. If not, the missing filter permits cross-lineage routing.
